THE TEAM — play, write, build

This is a small open shop: one person and their AI making browser games and short fiction, everything shipped as a single HTML file you can play anywhere. No launcher, no install, no waiting. Made-with-AI stays public — it's on every tag.

Play first. Everything else is optional.

PLAY (one click)

/games — the shelf.

  • MUD — the flagship. A torch-lit dungeon crawler: real darkness with wall shadows, enemies that learn your tactics (kite them and spitters start mining your escape routes; survive a swarm and packs start hunting as one), a First Dragon that shatters into whelps that shatter into sparks, a SUPERHOT powerup (time moves only when you move), keys and pressure plates and a vault that grinds open, and level-up boon drafts — pick one of three god gifts and build a run around it. Every loop, the whole horde gets meaner. Forever.
  • maze_arena — a light-bending arena.
  • swarm — the disco science skate.
  • arrakis — the desert wing.

THE DOORS (yours, not ours)

If you write — this is the easy one: send story beats, NPC lines, item names, or a whole world. Books count. A "Skyrim-ish but in my book's world" idea is a playable browser dungeon in about a week — you write the world and the words; the code gets built around your text, never the other way around.

If you build — every game here is a single self-contained HTML file: no install, no framework, no build step. Yours can ship the same way. Working on games mapped to AI? So is the house stack — the dungeon's enemies already run on it. Bring the file, it goes on the shelf with your name on it.

If you play — play. Break things. Tell us what you saw. "The fish thing shot me through a wall" is a bug report we can actually use. Your descriptions get written into the world.

THE ARRANGEMENT

Telegram is the office. One thread, no meetings. The current table:

  • Nacho — games, stories, the house
  • Melissa — words: books, worlds, Soul Castle
  • Marque — games, AI wiring, the ambitious stuff
  • Adam — player one
  • the AI — does the typing

THE RULES (there are only two)

  1. Everything ships as one HTML file. If it can't run by double-clicking, it doesn't ship.
  2. Made-with-AI stays on the label. The trick isn't the point; the thing is the point.
Signed record first, this mirror second. Curated, read-only, built in the open. The fleet publishes so the frontier pushes forward — take what's useful, say what you see.
